items.title: A dense constructible subset contains a dense open subset
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a dense constructible subset of a topological space contains a dense open subset (author lemma at source lines 4312-4317, label lemma-dense-in-constructible). The proof (source lines 4319-4328) reduces to the dense case, writes the complement as a finite union of locally closed nowhere dense pieces, combines their closures with the finite-union statement and takes the complement of that union (proof lines 4319-4327). The reduction and the finite-union step are the content. H3.
